• Brand Introduction: Welcome to the world of Yukulighter, where exceptional designs meet functionality in our collection of custom-designed lighters. Our brand is dedicated to adding a touch of elegance and style to everyday moments.

• Product Description: Explore our exclusive range of custom-designed lighters that transcend the ordinary. Each lighter is meticulously crafted to not only ignite a flame but also spark conversations with its unique designs and quality craftsmanship.

• USP (Unique Selling Point): At Yukulighter, we stand apart with our unparalleled designs that illuminate both spaces and conversations. Our commitment to blending style and functionality sets us apart, making our lighters a must-have accessory for trendsetters.

• Payment Terms: Join our affiliate program and unlock a remarkable 20% commission on total referral sales. Earn whenever customers purchase through your affiliate link or use your designated coupon code. Rest assured, our average order value of $70 ensures lucrative returns per sale.

• Other Information: Your journey with Yukulighter is not only financially rewarding but also backed by exclusive resources. Access high-quality marketing materials, including graphics, banners, pay-per-click keywords, and more. Stay connected through our affiliate admin portal, and if you have any questions, reach out to us at kuyulighter@gmail.com

Elevate your earnings while sharing designs that illuminate lives. Become a Yukulighter affiliate today!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Yuku Lighter Affiliate Program! Thank you for joining us.

Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

These terms and conditions apply to both affiliates ("you") and merchants ("we") participating in our Affiliate program. By engaging with our program, you agree to adhere to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please refrain from registering as an Affiliate and participating in the Program.

1. Registration Approval or Rejection

We hold the right to approve or reject Affiliate Program Registrations at our sole discretion. Rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration will not hold us liable or be subject to legal recourse.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are generated automatically, but you can also create links for specific products or collections. If a user clicks on another person's referral link before yours, only yours will be considered.

Affiliates may or may not be assigned a specific coupon code with details outlined in the Dashboard. Usage of both an affiliate link and coupon code in a purchase will not result in double commission. Only affiliates assigned a branded coupon are authorized to promote it.

Affiliates are permitted to promote our website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, as well as offline mediums like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payments

When you refer a customer to make a purchase on our website, you'll receive a commission based on the Commission structure. Commissions are calculated on the order value, excluding additional fees (tax, shipping, etc.).

To receive commissions, specify payment details in the Settings. The payment schedule will be communicated on the Affiliate Guide page.

Commissions will be paid out only for successfully completed transactions. The fair use policy empowers us to review each referral order. Commission status can be found in the Commission tab, and paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. No payment will be made for transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds.

4. Marketing Tools

Marketing materials like banners, logos, and specific collection promotions can be accessed through the Marketing Tools tab. Download media or obtain HTML embed codes for sharing on affiliate platforms.

5. Network

If the Network tab is active, affiliates can invite others to become downline affiliates. When a downline affiliate brings orders to our shop, the upline affiliate receives network commissions based on merchant settings.

To invite affiliates, share the network link, and anyone who clicks and signs up becomes a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

Cookies are used to track users who click on your link. If a user doesn't accept or clears cookies, their activity can't be tracked, and earnings won't be paid for it.

The cookie duration is specified during Affiliate registration. The tracking starts when a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie duration, every order by this customer on our website automatically generates commissions for the affiliate (no need for the customer to click the link again).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If you wish to leave the affiliate program, contact us at kuyulighter@gmail.com.

Moving Forward

Congratulations on reaching the end of this document. We wish you the best in your affiliate journey. Remember, you can always revisit these terms and conditions. For questions or support, email kuyulighter@gmail.com.
